title: rhobound.change/v1
description: A change set (DATA.md 11.2): what `predict --fit F --changes C` and `preview` apply. The server writes the agent's items into such a file with label declared, adds the measured items it resolved from its own records, and passes the file to the CLI; it never builds an argument string from names. Labels are checked, not trusted: any label other than declared must cite evidence the CLI can resolve to a record it computed (change.label_not_minted otherwise). Operations other than own_ms, own_pct, workers and load_scale are refused with change.unsupported_op in this version. Some documents outside this schema are refused by name, not as a shape error, because they are the usual ways a wrong number arrives: an item with a route key (change.route_scope_unsupported); an item with a source key of cpu-profile (change.cpu_profile_not_own_time), canary or histogram (change.includes_queueing) or microbenchmark (change.microbench_unvalidated); a value written as a string (change.free_text); the label estimated-microbench (change.microbench_unvalidated).

fit.description: the fit record the items were written against; "" means the fit given on the command line. The server always writes the digest; a digest other than the fit's is refused

evidence.description: the records (A/B record, verified profile) a label other than declared rests on
